title: Phase 7 follow-up: fix block check, E2E, delegate pattern, write race, orphaned models
description:
Fix 5 review-flagged issues from Phase 7 messaging PR:
1. Block check on sendMessage — MessagingPolicyService only checks block at conversation creation, not when sending messages. A blocked user keeps receiving messages after block.
2. E2E tests mock entire PrismaService — tests pass even if implementation is materially wrong (false confidence).
3. MessagingPolicyService reimplements ConnectionsPolicyService.isBlocked — should delegate to existing policy instead of raw prisma.block.findFirst.
4. lastMessageAt write race — concurrent sends can leave denorm fields pointing at older message (last-writer-wins). Monotonic guard partially added via updateMany OR but needs verification.
5. MessageAttachment / MessageReadState schema models orphaned — schema defines them but no code path uses them. PRD deferred but migration created empty tables.
